prompt:
Use the attached image as the reference: the same woman — the personification of Technetium (Tc) — seen off duty in her everyday life. Keep her face, eye colour, hair colour, skin tone and body exactly; change only her clothes, pose and place. Do not reuse earlier conversation images.

Output: one vertical 2:3 image, 1024×1536.

Face: exactly the attached image's face — the same short midface and face length-to-width ratio; the camera angle, pose, bangs or a headpiece never make her face look longer or her jaw heavier.

Style: A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish. Keep this rendering exactly as in the attached image — the same finish, line, shading, skin and colour treatment.

Place: a rooftop or terrace above the town of her element's kingdom
Hair: her hair let down loose over her shoulders — same colour and length as the attached image.
Outfit: a cropped hoodie and short shorts — in a clear pattern such as a floral print, bold stripes, gingham or plaid, in two or three cheerful colours; the outfit colour reads clearly at first glance, showing her shoulders, collarbones and legs as far as the outfit allows, following her curvy figure — a slim waist and rounded hips; intimate areas covered.
POSTURE: seated sideways on a stool or bench, her torso turned toward the camera.
COMPOSITION: a three-quarter shot from her head to just above the knees; body turned three-quarters toward the camera; camera at her eye level; a soft out-of-focus object of the place sits in the near foreground at one edge of the frame.
Lens / perspective: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.
RIGHT HAND: her own right hand is in PROP.
LEFT HAND: her own left hand is in PROP.
PROP: with both hands she folds a freshly washed sheet against her chest — her own right hand brings one corner across, her own left hand holds the folded edge.
GAZE: her eyes rest on what she holds.
EXPRESSION: softly lowered brows, warm relaxed eyes, faint closed-lip smile, no tension anywhere.

Leave behind everything she wears in the attached image — no crown, tiara, helmet, feathers, headpiece, hairpins from it, armour or regalia; her hair is styled for the everyday outfit, with at most one small accessory.

Her element — technetium: a silvery-grey metal and the first element made by human hands, found in 1937 in a strip of molybdenum sent across the ocean from a cyclotron and later named from the Greek word for artificial; the lightest element with no stable isotope, so almost none survives on Earth; for decades the gap below manganese held only mistaken claims, yet in 1952 its lines were seen in the light of red giant stars, proof that stars forge elements; today it is the most used medical tracer, lighting up bones and hearts — may show in the outfit's details, motifs or small accessories.

Figure: lean and toned — a slim, firm waist with softly defined vertical abs and lightly sculpted arms and shoulders, a full bust — keep this exact build from the attached image, neither slimmer nor fuller.

Light: the place's own light, lit and coloured the way this style renders light and skin.

One figure in focus, natural hands with five fingers, no text, logo or watermark.
